title: Mapping Africa: crop field boundary labels for Africa, 2017-2023
description:
Crop field boundaries digitised by trained labellers over Planet NICFI monthly basemaps at
sites (0.005° cells, about 550 m) across 39 African countries, 2017-2023, from the
[Lacuna Fund](https://lacunafund.org/) project led by [Farmerline](https://farmerline.co/)
with [Spatial Collective](https://spatialcollective.com/) and the Agricultural Impacts
Research Group at Clark University ([lacunalabels](https://github.com/agroimpacts/lacunalabels)).

Only the assignments in the project's filtered label catalog are kept, which is one labelling
per site; sites labelled with no fields have no rows. Each field is dated by the month of the
basemap it was digitised on. `label_class` is the catalog's assignment class (1a, 1b, 1d:
expert-labelled quality-control sites; 2: one labeller; 4: one of three labellers), and
`qscore` / `rscore` are the labeller's quality scores against the expert labels: one value
per labeller, not per field.

The labels are not wall-to-wall: fields can be missing from a site, so unlabelled land is
unknown, not non-field.

Estes, L. D., Wussah, A., Asipunu, M., Gathigi, M., Kovačič, P., Muhando, J.,
Yeboah, B. V., Addai, F. K., Akakpo, E. S., Allotey, M. K., Amkoya, P., Amponsem, E.,
Donkoh, K. D., Ha, N., Heltzel, E., Juma, C., Mdawida, R., Miroyo, A., Mucha, J.,
Mugami, J., Mwawaza, F., Nyarko, D. A., Oduor, P., Ohemeng, K. N., Segbefia, S. I. D.,
Tumbula, T., Wambua, F., Xeflide, G. H., Ye, S., Yeboah, F.(2024). A region-wide,
multi-year set of crop field boundary labels for Africa. arXiv:2412.18483.

The labels are published at https://zenodo.org/records/11060871 and can be used in accordance
with [Planet's participant license agreement for the NICFI contract](https://go.planet.com/nicfi-pla-2024).

This collection holds 7 editions (2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023), one GeoParquet file per year under `year=<year>/` (hive layout). Read them all at once with the partition glob `s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/lacuna/year=*/*.parquet` (S3 through the Source Cooperative proxy, endpoint `https://data.source.coop`; plain https cannot expand `*`); the `data` asset is a copy of the latest edition (2023). Geometries are kept in the source CRS (EPSG:4326). Converted with [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli) into the [fiboa](https://github.com/fiboa/specification) schema; tested queries are in the collection's [AGENTS.md](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/lacuna/AGENTS.md).

Boundaries are mapped: an authority delineated them from imagery or survey, with no farmer's declaration behind them.

providers.name: Agricultural Impacts Research Group, Clark University

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: A geometry that reflects the footprint of the field, usually a Polygon. Stored in the source CRS (see `proj:code`), not reprojected. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: determination:datetime
table:columns.description: The last timestamp at which the field did exist and was observed. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: admin:country_code
table:columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (aka admin0). Two-letter country code for the country that contains the field. ([spec](https://github.com/vecorel/administrative-division-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: site
table:columns.description: Carried over from the source column `name`; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: assignment_id
table:columns.description: Source-specific column; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: label_class
table:columns.description: Carried over from the source column `Class`; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: labeller
table:columns.description: Carried over from the source column `Labeller`; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: qscore
table:columns.description: Carried over from the source column `Qscore`; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: rscore
table:columns.description: Carried over from the source column `Rscore`; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: label_category
table:columns.description: Carried over from the source column `category`; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: completion_time
table:columns.description: Source-specific column; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: metrics:area
table:columns.description: Area of the field, in square meters (m²). Must be > 0 and <= 1,000,000,000. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: The bounding box of the field. Per-feature covering column (GeoParquet 1.1), in the source CRS. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

partition:keys.name: year
partition:keys.description: The year the boundaries represent (the season, declaration or snapshot year). Not a column in the files; DuckDB adds it with hive_partitioning=true. Expand the glob through S3 (endpoint data.source.coop, path style); plain https has no listing.

data.title: Mapping Africa — latest edition (2023) (GeoParquet)
data.description: Byte-identical copy of `year=2023/lacuna-2023.parquet`, kept at a stable path so `*/latest/*.parquet` selects the newest edition of every collection.

style-field-size.title: Field size (ha)
style-field-size.description: Fields shaded light to dark by area in hectares (metrics:area / 10 000). Stops at 0.25, 0.5, 1 ha, the nice values nearest this dataset's 20th/40th/60th/80th percentiles so each class holds a similar share of fields.

style-outline.title: Field boundaries
style-outline.description: Every field in one colour with a thin outline; for reading the boundaries themselves.
